name: Attribution (Public domain, CC BY-SA 4.0 and ODbL)
content:
USGS The National Map: public domain.

OpenTopoMap: map style CC BY-SA, from OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) and SRTM.

Terrain Tiles by Mapzen, from USGS 3DEP, SRTM, GMTED2010, NOAA ETOPO1, Copernicus EU-DEM and others.

Forage and Streets: © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL), https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright, through the Overpass API.

Edible plant locations from Falling Fruit and its sources, under each dataset's license (mostly ODbL).
